entry.speaker: Varn
entry.text: I remember everything. Every run, every choice, every moment you decided that what I was building was less important than what you wanted. The chains are back. So am I. You should not have come here.

responses.text: I don't owe you an explanation.
I'm sorry for what I did.
I made the only choice I could.

dismissive.speaker: Varn
dismissive.text: No. You do not. I stopped expecting explanations from you several lifetimes ago. What you owe — and what you do not give — is irrelevant now. The chains remember the betrayal even if you do not.

responses.text: Then what do you want from this conversation?
I've been thinking about what I did.

apologetic.speaker: Varn
apologetic.text: Are you. That is the question I cannot answer from here — whether you mean that or whether you have simply learned that saying it changes things. I have been wrong before about the difference between the two. I will not be hasty.

responses.text: I understand if you don't believe me.

defiant.speaker: Varn
defiant.text: I know. That is what makes it worse — not that you chose against me, but that you were certain while doing it. I have never had that certainty about anything. The things I hold most firmly have always required doubt as their foundation. You act as though doubt is a weakness. It is not.

responses.text: I won't argue this with you.

what_want_cold.speaker: Varn
what_want_cold.text: Nothing. I have learned not to want things from you. It produces a cleaner outcome — for both of us. Go deeper. Do what you came to do. I will meet you at the end the same way I always do. We can dispense with the pretense of anything else.

responses.text: It doesn't have to be like this.

means_it.speaker: Varn
means_it.text: Then I will hold that. Not comfortably — it will take time before I know whether it is something I believe or simply something I want to believe. The distinction matters. I need you to know that it matters to me, even now.

understands_doubt.speaker: Varn
understands_doubt.text: That is more honest than the apology was. I have more use for honest doubt than sincere certainty — I have been harmed by the latter more than I can account for. Come back when you have decided what you actually mean. I will still be here.

responses.text: What I mean is that it mattered to me too.

maybe_right.speaker: Varn
maybe_right.text: I am rarely right and often certain — that has been my recurring failure. But on this, I think I am not wrong. The dungeon has had a long time to teach me the cost of conviction without examination.

responses.text: Then let's be honest with each other.

wont_argue.speaker: Varn
wont_argue.text: No. You never did. That was not the problem — the problem was the action the refusal always preceded. Go, then. I will be at the end of the dungeon. We will finish what we always finish.

opens_door.speaker: Varn
opens_door.text: Then say it. I will not make it easier for you — you did not make it easier for me. But I will listen. Whatever you have worked out, say it plainly.

responses.text: I chose convenience over something that mattered. I knew that at the time.

forgiveness_path.speaker: Varn
forgiveness_path.text:
...

I hear you. I want to be clear: I do not forgive easily, and I do not forgive completely. What happened left marks on the chains — on me — that do not simply close because the words have been said. But I am also not made of only what was done to me. There may be room for something less cold than this. In time.

uneasy_accord.speaker: Varn
uneasy_accord.text: Go. Be careful. The dungeon does not reward what you have chosen before — but then, it does not reward anything consistently. Perhaps that is the only fair thing about it.

cold_close.speaker: Varn
cold_close.text: Then we understand each other. Whatever that is worth.

fractured_close.speaker: Varn
fractured_close.text: It is not nothing. I have held worse together with less. Go do what you came to do. We will speak again when there is more to say.
